verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself the AI assistant. Users describe tasks in plain language and it plans, edits code across multiple files and verifies the result. First-party docs also cover delegating routine work (tests, lint, merge conflicts), long-running background and cloud tasks, parallel sub-agents, and routing tasks from Slack or @claude on GitHub. Independent daily-use reports confirm real delegation, though some describe unreliable self-verification. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable task completion (hands-on reports cite self-verification failures and degraded output).
